texte.Plan de sensibilisation par public cible: Awareness plan by target audience and frequency.
texte.Plan de sensibilisation à la protection: Data protection awareness plan: actions by target audience, frequency, completion. A compliance culture is what prevents the incidents that documentation can only record.
texte.Plan de surveillance post-commercialisat: Post-market monitoring plan documented before placing on the market. Collection and analysis of post-deployment data. Reporting of serious incidents to the national authorities.
texte.Plan documenté de collecte et d'analyse: Documented plan for collecting and analysing usage data throughout the lifetime of the system.
texte.Planification automatisee des deplacemen: Automated planning of the movement of parts and products.
texte.Planification dynamique des trajets selo: Dynamic route planning according to traffic and demand.
texte.Planifiez les actions de sensibilisation: Plan the awareness actions by target audience and frequency.
texte.Planifiez l’audit interne et la revue de: Schedule the internal audit and the management review BEFORE requesting stage #.
texte.Plateformes : articulation EU AI Act / D: Platforms: interplay between the EU AI Act and the Digital Services Act. Transparency of recommender and moderation systems.
texte.Plus strict encore, au prix d’un frottem: Stricter still, at the cost of real friction on new projects. Consistent with a reproducible build chain.
texte.Plusieurs tiennent à une propriété du pr: Several stem from a property of the technique and not from an implementation defect: for those, everything that is built is mitigation.
texte.Point d’entrée du dispositif RGPD : cart: Entry point to the GDPR compliance framework: map the processing, assess the risks, document, raise awareness, steer. All the building blocks are linked — the records of processing feed the map, which triggers the DPIAs.
texte.Politique IA (clause #) et rôles (clause: AI policy (clause #) and roles (clause #, Annex A.#)
texte.Politique de droit d’auteur respectee et: Copyright policy complied with and documented (Art. #(#)(c))
texte.Politiques et procédures : stratégie rég: Policies and procedures: regulatory strategy, design, testing, incidents, post-market monitoring.
texte.Politiques et procédures conformes à l'E: Policies and procedures compliant with the EU AI Act + practical guides per team.
texte.Politiques, procedures et instructions e: Documented written policies, procedures and instructions
texte.Porter les risques du projet dans la mat: Enter the project’s risks in the matrix
texte.Portée extraterritoriale : qui est conce: Extraterritorial scope: who is concerned outside the EU
texte.Poser ses limites soi-même est ce qui re: Setting your own limits is what makes the rest credible: a plan that promises # % everywhere unravels at the first precise question.
texte.Posez le RACI des rôles liés à l’IA : qu: Set out the RACI for AI-related roles: who decides, who executes, who is consulted, who is informed.
texte.Positionne vos systèmes réels du Registr: Positions the actual systems in your AI register on a Likelihood of non-compliance × Impact grid, so you can spot the priorities at a glance.
texte.Positionnement gravité × probabilité ; a: Severity × likelihood positioning; no hidden weighting.
texte.Positionnement gravité × probabilité, sa: Severity × likelihood positioning, with no hidden weighting. No overall score masks an isolated gap.
texte.Positionnement post-Brexit pro-innovatio: Pro-innovation post-Brexit positioning. The AI Safety Institute monitors foundation models. Risk of regulatory divergence from the EU.
texte.Positionnez chaque système selon sa prob: Position each system according to its likelihood of failure and its potential impact.
texte.Positionnez chaque système sur les axes: Position each system on the likelihood × impact axes.
texte.Positionnez les cas d’usage retenus en p: Position the selected use cases by likelihood × impact.
texte.Positionnez les risques identifiés sur l: Position the identified risks on the likelihood × impact axes and document the mitigation measures adopted.
texte.Positionnez les risques par gravité et p: Position the risks by severity and likelihood.
texte.Positionnez les risques relevés aux deux: Position the risks identified in the two previous steps — grid connection, water, permits, competition on the grid — by severity and likelihood.
texte.Possibilite d’ignorer, corriger ou annul: Ability to disregard, override or reverse AI decisions (Art. #(#)(c))
texte.Possibilité de confirmer, modifier ou an: Ability to confirm, modify or cancel
texte.Postes frequemment sous-estimes — a anti: Items frequently underestimated — to anticipate for a realistic budget.
texte.Potentiellement interdit (Art. #). Simul: Potentially prohibited (Art. #). Simulate as a priority — a decision to abandon is possible before any investment.
texte.Potentiellement — Annexe III point # si: Potentially — Annex III, point # if used as a safety component of critical infrastructure
texte.Pour celui-ci, le régime réglementaire a: For this one, the regulatory regime has been identified in the texts, but
texte.Pour chaque cas prioritaire, l’artefact: For each priority case, the before / after artefact from step #: what the machine does, what the human keeps, what disappears, who arbitrates.
texte.Pour chaque point de contrôle, indiquez: For each checkpoint, state your actual status (compliant / in progress / to be done). The overall score is calculated automatically. The # Map/Assess/Plan cards at the top of the page summarise your situation and offer downloadable reports.
texte.Pour classifier un nouveau système IA, u: To classify a new AI system, use the AI Act simulator (Map section). To audit your compliance in detail, use the AI Act audit (Assess risk section).
texte.Pour les GPAI à risque systémique : éval: For GPAI with systemic risk: model evaluation (red-teaming), assessment and mitigation of systemic risks, reporting of incidents to the Commission, cybersecurity measures.
texte.Pour les cas restés incomplets ci-dessou: For the cases left incomplete below, this figure describes a gain that nothing will go and collect.
texte.Pour les fournisseurs hors UE : désigner: For providers outside the EU: appoint an EU authorised representative by written mandate
texte.Pour les organisations hors UE : désigne: For organisations outside the EU: appoint an EU authorised representative (Art. #) if the system is used in the EU
texte.Pour les systèmes haut risque Annexe III: For Annex III high-risk systems: FRIA mandatory before deployment (Art. #).
texte.Pour modifier les rôles ou leur assignat: To change the roles or their assignment, go to the Stakeholders page — this page is a read-only reflection of it.
texte.Pour un texte exact, allez aux Réglement: For the exact text, go to Regulations, which quote the Regulation article by article. This page gives its reading, not its letter.
texte.Pour un établissement de crédit, le repo: For a credit institution, the postponement to midday on the following working day does NOT apply to the initial notification. The clock runs on Saturday.
texte.Pourquoi certains systèmes n’ont pas d’h: Why some systems have no hosting counted
texte.Pratiques absentes ou ad hoc. Risque de: Practices absent or ad hoc. High risk of non-compliance.
texte.Pre-traitement et orientation des demand: Pre-processing and routing of citizens’ requests (benefits, permits).
texte.Premières mesures en place mais incomplè: First measures in place but incomplete and not systematic.
texte.Prenez les modèles de documentation qui: Take the documentation templates that match what you have just established, rather than redoing a presentation.
texte.Prenez les six décisions d’architecture: Take the six architecture decisions one by one, each time reading the written consequence that accompanies it.
texte.Preparation d arguments et de scenarios: Preparation of arguments and scenarios for supplier negotiations.
texte.Presse, réseaux, sites concurrents, dépô: Press, social networks, competitor sites, trade mark filings.
texte.Prestataire de services TIC — je sers de: ICT service provider — I serve financial entities
texte.Prestataires utilisant l'IA dans leurs l: Service providers using AI in their deliverables
texte.Preuves de revue humaine : que reste-t-i: Evidence of human review: what is left six months later?
texte.Prevision d occupation pour optimiser la: Occupancy forecasting to optimise hospital capacity management.
texte.Priorisation automatique des prospects s: Automatic prioritisation of prospects according to likelihood of conversion.
texte.Priorisation automatisee des urgences se: Automated prioritisation of emergencies according to estimated severity.
texte.Priorisation des cas d'usage IA à potent: Prioritisation of AI use cases with potential.
texte.Priorisation des dossiers d aide sociale: Prioritisation of social assistance files according to vulnerability criteria.
texte.Prioriser dans le Registre — fort risque: Prioritise in the register — high risk of employment tribunal litigation.
texte.Priorité # — bonne pratique recommandée,: Priority # — recommended good practice, strengthens the robustness of the approach.
texte.Priorité # — obligation critique, direct: Priority # — critical obligation, directly subject to penalties (up to €#M or #% of worldwide turnover). To be addressed first.
texte.Priorité # — obligation importante, impa: Priority # — important obligation, significant impact on overall compliance.
texte.Privacy by Design (Art. # RGPD) : determ: Privacy by Design (Art. # GDPR): determine the applicable privacy requirements before going into production
texte.Privacy by design — protection dès la co: Privacy by design — data protection by design (art. # GDPR)
texte.Privilégier données synthétiques ou agré: Favour synthetic or aggregated data for training where performance allows
texte.Procedure de signalement des incidents g: Procedure for reporting serious incidents -- deadline # days (Art. #)
texte.Processus itératif continu sur tout le c: Continuous iterative process throughout the lifecycle: identification and analysis of known and foreseeable risks, estimation and evaluation, appropriate management measures, residual testing.
texte.Processus itératif documenté : identific: Documented iterative process: identification, estimation, evaluation and management of risks throughout the lifecycle.
texte.Procédure d'évaluation applicable au sys: Assessment procedure applicable to the system — internal control, or involvement of a notified body as the case may be.
texte.Procédure et registre des violations de: Procedure and register of data breaches (art. #-#)
texte.Production assistee de visuels et textes: Assisted production of advertising visuals and copy.
texte.Production culturelle, édition et audiov: Cultural production, publishing and audiovisual, sports clubs and facilities, parks and leisure, content platforms.
texte.Production, transport et distribution d': Energy production, transmission and distribution, electricity and gas network operators.
texte.Produire un reporting environnemental su: Produce environmental reporting on a digital estate knowing, for each figure, whether it is published, calculated from the site or inferred from a class.
texte.Profitez-en pour vérifier les deux dates: Take the opportunity to check the two dates: acceptance criteria established BEFORE the assessment. It is the most frequent gap, and the most invisible.
texte.Projection des depenses et recettes a pa: Projection of expenditure and revenue based on history.
texte.Projet de politique de développement ass: Draft AI-assisted development policy — prepared from Sentinel AI.
texte.Prolonger le parcours hors de cette page: Continue the path beyond this page
texte.Prompts systeme codes en dur par identif: System prompts hard-coded by page identifier (PAGE_CTX in the JS). To be maintained manually if the content of the pages changes significantly.
texte.Proposer et décider sont deux routes dif: Proposing and deciding are two different routes. The first has no write access to the “classification” column; the second writes it, and refuses without a person’s name.
texte.Proposition automatisee de variantes de: Automated proposal of design variants according to constraints.
texte.Protection contre les attaques adversari: Protection against adversarial attacks, prompt injection, data exfiltration. ISO # and ISO #.
texte.Protection des données de déplacement (R: Protection of travel data (GDPR). Minimisation and anonymisation of mobility traces.
texte.Protection des données dès la conception: Data protection by design and by default, art. #.
texte.Protection des modèles et des jeux de do: Protection of industrial models and datasets. Confidentiality of processes (trade secrets).
texte.Protection explicite contre la discrimin: Explicit protection against discrimination, right to an explanation, right of appeal against an automated decision.

texte.Prénom, nom et adresse électronique sont: First name, last name and email address are required.

texte.Préparer une procédure de réponse aux de: Prepare a procedure for responding to requests from supervisory authorities

texte.Préparez la documentation technique et l: Prepare the technical documentation and the EU declaration of conformity.
texte.Présente le périmètre de l’offre Entrepr: Presents the scope of the Enterprise plan: everything in the Pro plan, plus group-wide deployment, integration with your information system and dedicated contractual support.
texte.Présentez le palier comme un PLAFOND, ja: Present the tier as a CEILING, never as a forecast. Article #(#) modulates according to nature, duration, history and size — a single figure presented as certain turns against whoever puts it forward.
texte.Présentez les résultats avec leurs limit: Present the results with their explicit limits.
texte.Présentez toujours une fourchette (minim: Always present a range (minimum/maximum), never a single figure that could be contested.
texte.Présentez une fourchette de coûts, jamai: Present a cost range, never a single figure: a single figure gets contested, a range gets discussed.
texte.Présentez une fourchette plutôt qu’un ch: Present a range rather than a single figure: a single figure gets contested, a range gets discussed.
texte.Prévention des biais discriminatoires (g: Prevention of discriminatory bias (gender, origin, age) in diagnostic or triage models. Representativeness of the training data.
texte.Prévoir une procédure de réponse aux dem: Provide a procedure for responding to access requests that includes the logic of the AI system
texte.Publication des analyses d impact et tra: Publication of impact assessments and democratic transparency

texte.Qualification DÉTERMINISTE d’abord : jur: DETERMINISTIC qualification first: juridique.qualifier() establishes the applicable texts and those to be checked. The model comes in afterwards, on that list.
texte.Qualification déterministe des textes ap: Deterministic qualification of the applicable texts, then drafting. The clause library is a reference framework, not a generation.
texte.Qualification déterministe d’une demande: Deterministic qualification of a use request, then drafting. The server REFUSES a decision without a written reason (HTTP #).
texte.Qualifier formellement votre système sel: Formally qualify your system against the definition in Art. #(#) before classification
texte.Qualifiez chaque acteur de votre chaîne: Qualify each actor in your value chain, and record who supplies you with what.
texte.Qualifiez d’abord, puis lisez la colonne: Qualify first, then read the column of Annex A controls to tick off. Start with the “specific to DORA” rows: these are the ones where nothing exists, and where all the work remains to be done. The two reports on the review of the framework — Articles # and # — are among them: no control of the standard produces them.
texte.Qualifiez d’abord. Le taux est rendu par: Qualify first. The rate is given per chapter and the lowest is named: that is the one to address, because that is the one that will show in an inspection. An undeclared article counts as zero and stays in the denominator — silence does not lighten the requirement.
texte.Qualifiez rapidement chaque nouveau cas: Quickly qualify each new use case proposed by the business teams.
texte.Qualifiez-vous d’abord : essentielle, im: Qualify yourself first: essential, important or out of scope.
texte.Qualité, représentativité et traçabilité: Quality, representativeness and traceability of training data
texte.Qualité, représentativité, traçabilité d: Quality, representativeness, traceability of training data, validation and testing. Absence of bias verified.
texte.Quarante-deux mesures de l’annexe A répo: Forty-two Annex A controls answer the ten requirements of NIS #: the work already done can be presented as it stands.
texte.Quatre familles commandent les quatorze: Four families govern the other fourteen
texte.Quatre heures depuis la classification :: Four hours from classification: if you detect and it classifies, your alert deadline is already inside its own.
texte.Quatre heures depuis la classification,: Four hours from classification, twenty-four from awareness: the chain repeats itself, it is not ticked off.
texte.Quatre notes séparées, et l’avertissemen: Four separate scores, and the warning when the downstream gets ahead of the baseline by a full point.
texte.Quatre objets sur une même page, parce q: Four objects on the same page, because they explain one another: a panel of real cases of AI systems deployed in the EU (POCs, pilots, production, abandonments) classified under the AI Act; the regulatory layer of the # Member States; the estate of European data centres — # sites mapped with status, operator and cooling; and the environmental footprint of the whole, electricity, CO₂e, manufacturing and water. Added to these are a comparator of countries of location and seven guided paths by business line, chosen from two lists under the tabs. The common thread: each figure carries its NATURE — published, calculated, analysis — and its source.
